title: agentcn: shadcn for AI agents, one command drops a complete, ownable agent recipe into your project
description:
shadcn changed how the web gets built. Copy the components into your project and own them outright. agentcn applies that idea to agents. Copy-paste agent building blocks you own and customize, instead of a black-box framework you import and pray to. One shadcn add command drops a complete agent recipe into your project. Instructions, tools, skills, and workflows included. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/shadcn-labs/agentcn
